verses.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
verses.pt: Então respondeu Elifaz, o temanita:
verses.en_web: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
verses.en_bbe: And Eliphaz the Temanite made answer and said,

verses.en: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
verses.pt: Porventura responderá o sábio com ciência de vento? E encherá do vento oriental o seu ventre,
verses.en_web: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
verses.en_bbe: Will a wise man make answer with knowledge of no value, or will he give birth to the east wind?

verses.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
verses.pt: argüindo com palavras que de nada servem, ou com razões com que ele nada aproveita?
verses.en_web: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?
verses.en_bbe: Will he make arguments with words in which is no profit, and with sayings which have no value?

verses.en: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.
verses.pt: Na verdade tu destróis a reverência, e impedes a meditação diante de Deus.
verses.en_web: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, you make the fear of God without effect, so that the time of quiet worship before God is made less by your outcry.

verses.en: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
verses.pt: Pois a tua iniqüidade ensina a tua boca, e escolhes a língua dos astutos.
verses.en_web: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
verses.en_bbe: For your mouth is guided by your sin, and you have taken the tongue of the false for yourself.

verses.en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
verses.pt: A tua própria boca te condena, e não eu; e os teus lábios testificam contra ti.
verses.en_web: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
verses.en_bbe: It is by your mouth, even yours, that you are judged to be in the wrong, and not by me; and your lips give witness against you.

verses.en: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?
verses.pt: És tu o primeiro homem que nasceu? Ou foste dado à luz antes dos outeiros?
verses.en_web: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?
verses.en_bbe: Were you the first man to come into the world? or did you come into being before the hills?

verses.en: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
verses.pt: Ou ouviste o secreto conselho de Deus? E a ti só reservas a sabedoria?
verses.en_web: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
verses.en_bbe: Were you present at the secret meeting of God? and have you taken all wisdom for yourself?

verses.en: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?
verses.pt: Que sabes tu, que nós não saibamos; que entendes, que não haja em nós?
verses.en_web: What do you know, that we don’t know? What do you understand, which is not in us?
verses.en_bbe: What knowledge have you which we have not? is there anything in your mind which is not in ours?

verses.en: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.
verses.pt: Conosco estão os encanecidos e idosos, mais idosos do que teu pai.
verses.en_web: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.
verses.en_bbe: With us are men who are grey-haired and full of years, much older than your father.

verses.en: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?
verses.pt: Porventura fazes pouco caso das consolações de Deus, ou da palavra que te trata benignamente?
verses.en_web: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?
verses.en_bbe: Are the comforts of God not enough for you, and the gentle word which was said to you?

verses.en: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,
verses.pt: Por que te arrebata o teu coração, e por que flamejam os teus olhos,
verses.en_web: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,
verses.en_bbe: Why is your heart uncontrolled, and why are your eyes lifted up;

verses.en: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?
verses.pt: de modo que voltas contra Deus o teú espírito, e deixas sair tais palavras da tua boca?
verses.en_web: That you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?
verses.en_bbe: So that you are turning your spirit against God, and letting such words go out of your mouth?

verses.en: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.pt: Que é o homem, para que seja puro? E o que nasce da mulher, para que fique justo?
verses.en_web: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.en_bbe: What is man, that he may be clean? and how may the son of woman be upright?

verses.en: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
verses.pt: Eis que Deus não confia nos seus santos, e nem o céu é puro aos seus olhos;
verses.en_web: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
verses.en_bbe: Truly, he puts no faith in his holy ones, and the heavens are not clean in his eyes;

verses.en: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?
verses.pt: quanto menos o homem abominável e corrupto, que bebe a iniqüidade como a água?
verses.en_web: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
verses.en_bbe: How much less one who is disgusting and unclean, a man who takes in evil like water!

verses.en: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
verses.pt: Escuta-me e to mostrarei; contar-te-ei o que tenho visto
verses.en_web: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare
verses.en_bbe: Take note and give ear to my words; and I will say what I have seen:

verses.en: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:
verses.pt: (o que os sábios têm anunciado e seus pais não o ocultaram;
verses.en_web: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;
verses.en_bbe: (The things which wise men have got from their fathers, and have not kept secret from us;

verses.en: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.
verses.pt: aos quais somente era dada a terra, não havendo estranho algum passado por entre eles);
verses.en_web: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):
verses.en_bbe: For only to them was the land given, and no strange people were among them:)

verses.en: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
verses.pt: Todos os dias passa o ímpio em angústia, sim, todos os anos que estão reservados para o opressor.
verses.en_web: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
verses.en_bbe: The evil man is in pain all his days, and the number of the years stored up for the cruel is small.

verses.en: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
verses.pt: O sonido de terrores está nos seus ouvidos; na prosperidade lhe sobrevém o assolador.
verses.en_web: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer shall come on him.
verses.en_bbe: A sound of fear is in his ears; in time of peace destruction will come on him:

verses.en: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
verses.pt: Ele não crê que tornará das trevas, mas que o espera a espada.
verses.en_web: He doesn’t believe that he shall return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
verses.en_bbe: He has no hope of coming safe out of the dark, and his fate will be the sword;

verses.en: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.pt: Anda vagueando em busca de pão, dizendo: Onde está? Bem sabe que o dia das trevas lhe está perto, à mão.
verses.en_web: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.en_bbe: He is wandering about in search of bread, saying, Where is it? and he is certain that the day of trouble is ready for him:

verses.en: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.pt: Amedrontam-no a angústia e a tribulação; prevalecem contra ele, como um rei preparado para a peleja.
verses.en_web: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.en_bbe: He is greatly in fear of the dark day, trouble and pain overcome him:

verses.en: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
verses.pt: Porque estendeu a sua mão contra Deus, e contra o Todo-Poderoso se porta com soberba;
verses.en_web: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty;
verses.en_bbe: Because his hand is stretched out against God, and his heart is lifted up against the Ruler of all,

verses.en: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
verses.pt: arremete contra ele com dura cerviz, e com as saliências do seu escudo;
verses.en_web: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers;
verses.en_bbe: Running against him like a man of war, covered by his thick breastplate; even like a king ready for the fight,

verses.en: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.
verses.pt: porquanto cobriu o seu rosto com a sua gordura, e criou carne gorda nas ilhargas;
verses.en_web: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
verses.en_bbe: Because his face is covered with fat, and his body has become thick;

verses.en: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
verses.pt: e habitou em cidades assoladas, em casas em que ninguem deveria morar, que estavam a ponto de tornar-se em montões de ruínas;
verses.en_web: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
verses.en_bbe: And he has made his resting-place in the towns which have been pulled down, in houses where no man had a right to be, whose fate was to become masses of broken walls.

verses.en: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
verses.pt: não se enriquecerá, nem subsistirá a sua fazenda, nem se estenderão pela terra as suas possessões.
verses.en_web: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall their possessions be extended on the earth.
verses.en_bbe: He does not get wealth for himself, and is unable to keep what he has got; the heads of his grain are not bent down to the earth.

verses.en: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
verses.pt: Não escapará das trevas; a chama do fogo secará os seus ramos, e ao sopro da boca de Deus desaparecerá.
verses.en_web: He shall not depart out of darkness. The flame shall dry up his branches. By the breath of God’s mouth shall he go away.
verses.en_bbe: He does not come out of the dark; his branches are burned by the flame, and the wind takes away his bud.

verses.en: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
verses.pt: Não confie na vaidade, enganando-se a si mesmo; pois a vaidade será a sua recompensa.
verses.en_web: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself; for emptiness shall be his reward.
verses.en_bbe: Let him not put his hope in what is false, falling into error: for he will get deceit as his reward.

verses.en: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.
verses.pt: Antes do seu dia se cumprirá, e o seu ramo não reverdecerá.
verses.en_web: It shall be accomplished before his time. His branch shall not be green.
verses.en_bbe: His branch is cut off before its time, and his leaf is no longer green.

verses.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
verses.pt: Sacudirá as suas uvas verdes, como a vide, e deixará cair a sua flor como a oliveira.
verses.en_web: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive tree.
verses.en_bbe: He is like a vine whose grapes do not come to full growth, or an olive-tree dropping its flowers.

verses.en: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
verses.pt: Pois a assembléia dos ímpios é estéril, e o fogo consumirá as tendas do suborno.
verses.en_web: For the company of the godless shall be barren, and fire shall consume the tents of bribery.
verses.en_bbe: For the band of the evil-doers gives no fruit, and the tents of those who give wrong decisions for reward are burned with fire.

verses.en: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
verses.pt: Concebem a malícia, e dão à luz a iniqüidade, e o seu coração prepara enganos.
verses.en_web: They conceive mischief, and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
verses.en_bbe: Evil has made them with child, and they give birth to trouble; and the fruit of their body is shame for themselves.
